brief.attributes: A house endures when ordinary labour and mutual obligation continue without certainty that the absent owner will ever reward them.
brief.assessment: Keep as household-pattern engine, not a single scene. The resilience should feel collective rather than like a hidden named hero.

candidate.text: Home survived twenty years because some people kept doing tomorrow's work.
candidate.basis: Eumaeus and the loyal household preserve ordinary duties through Odysseus's long absence.
candidate.fit: Directly supports the tapped-labour/endurance engine.

brief.sourceReview: Odyssey XII checked: the crew is repeatedly ordered to row hard, quicken the stroke and maintain course through danger. The phrase 'Every Oar in Rhythm' is a set-level synthesis of coordinated rowing, not a quoted ancient formulation.
brief.attributes: Collective technique made visible: many small repeated motions become speed, safety and eventually material advantage.
brief.assessment: Keep as crew composite. Test timing of the power bonus separately from the flavour.

candidate.text: No single stroke carried the ship. The voyage belonged to the rhythm between them.
candidate.basis: Odyssey XII repeatedly foregrounds coordinated rowing under command.
candidate.fit: Matches two tapped workers producing value and crew participation.

brief.sourceReview: Odyssey VIII and XXIV checked as reception concept: Demodocus shows performance preserving events beyond participants, while the poem's closing world is crowded by stories of people already dead. The card is about transmission after the performer, not one literal scene.
brief.attributes: Cultural memory survives its carrier: a singer can die while the pattern of story, refrain and recognition remains available to someone else.
brief.assessment: Keep distinct from Kleos: heroes seek or receive renown; this card is about the medium that continues after both hero and performer.

candidate.text: The singer ends. The song becomes someone else's memory.
candidate.basis: Demodocus demonstrates performed memory; the later poem remains populated by stories outliving their subjects.
candidate.fit: A concise statement of the card's death/departure draw trigger.
